periscian.definition: a. Having the shadow moving all around.

periscii.definition:
n. pl. Those who live within a polar circle, whose shadows,
   during some summer days, will move entirely round, falling toward every
   point of the compass.

periscope.definition: n. an optical instrument that provides a view of an otherwise obstructed field
periscope.translation:
n. 潜望镜(镜头)
[化] 潜望镜

periscoped.definition:
past tense of periscope
n. an optical instrument that provides a view of an otherwise obstructed field

periscopic.definition:
a. Viewing all around, or on all sides.
a. of or relating to a periscope{2}.
periscopic.translation:
a. 潜望镜的, 用潜望镜的, 大角度的
[医] 周视的(广阔视野的)

periscopical.translation: a. 潜望镜的, 用潜望镜的, 大角度的

perish.definition: v pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life
perish.translation:
vi. 毁灭, 丧生, 凋谢, 颓丧, 死亡, 腐烂
vt. 毁坏, 使麻木, 使丧生, 耗尽

n. 易腐坏的东西

perishableness.definition:
n. The quality or state of being perishable; liability
   to decay or destruction.

perishables.definition: n. food that will decay rapidly if not refrigerated
perishables.translation: n. 容易腐坏的东西（尤指食品）( perishable的复数形式 )

perishably.definition: adv. In a perishable degree or manner.

perished.translation: v. 丧生( perish的过去式和过去分词 ); 消亡; 死亡; 损坏

perishing.translation: a. 使人痛苦的, 致命的, 讨厌的, 糟糕的

perishment.translation:
死亡
毁灭

   echinoderm or coelenterate; the integument.

perisperm.translation: n. [植]外胚乳( 亦泛指胚乳, 包括内、 外胚乳)

   syllable.

a. (希腊语中)音调(或长音)符号落在最后一个音节上的
n. 音调(或长音)符号落在最后一个音节上的词

perispore.definition: n. The outer covering of a spore.

perissad.definition:
a. Odd; not even; -- said of elementary substances and of
   radicals whose valence is not divisible by two without a remainder.
   Contrasted with artiad.
perissad.translation:
[化]n.奇价原子(或元素)
a. 奇价的

   contraction of the muscular fibers of their walls, forcing their
   contents onwards; as, peristaltic movement.
peristaltic.translation:
a. 蠕动的, 蠕动引起的
[医] 蠕动的

peristerite.definition:
n. A variety of albite, whitish and slightly iridescent

n. (botany) fringe of toothlike appendages surrounding the mouth of a moss capsule
